desc: Derive and verify reverse processing: value `i` occupies the `P_i`-th free final position when processed from `N` down to `1`.
Implement a Fenwick tree initialized with all `N` positions free.
Implement Fenwick binary lifting to find the index of the k-th free slot.
Fill the answer by processing `i` from `N` down to `1`, mark selected slots occupied, and print the result.
Verify all-front insertions, all-end insertions, and the provided examples.
